items.description: Mark Carney a été accueilli avec enthousiasme au Parlement européen à Strasbourg. Le Premier ministre canadien a prononcé en fin de matinée jeudi 17 septembre un discours en forme de plaidoyer pour une alliance la plus solide et la plus resserrée possible. L’Europe et le Canada peuvent devenir par cette alliance un « phare pour les démocraties » menacées par la montée des souverainismes et des régimes autoritaires, a notamment déclaré le Premier ministre canadien.

items.summary: Cinq ans après le retour au pouvoir des talibans, l’Afghanistan traverse l'une des crises de la faim les plus sévères au monde. items.title: Le stock d’eau douce de la planète au plus bas depuis plus de 30 ans, l’OMM alerte sur les graves conséquences

Les scientifiques s'inquiètent de la poursuite du déclin à long terme des réserves d'eau douce et du recul des glaciers. items.description: En 2025, les cours d'eau du monde entier ont connu l'une des années les plus sèches depuis plus de 30 ans, souligne un nouveau rapport de l'Organisation météorologique mondiale (OMM). items.summary: Key steam turbine components - including high-pressure turbines and valve casings - for Rolls-Royce SMR's first three small modular reactors at the Gwyndod project on Anglesey in North Wales, will be manufactured at Germany-based Siemens Energy's facility in Newcastle, in northeast England.

items.title: Viewpoint: Fusion's lessons from fission, as commercial deployments approach
items.summary: The prospect of fusion power plants is coming closer. But what are the lessons fusion can learn from nuclear fission in areas such as regulation, planning, public approval and finance? Ahead of the UK Fusion Forum , Tris Denton, UK Director of the Fusion Industry Association, considers the issues.

items.title: Saltfoss enlists Korean services for MSR development
items.summary: The Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute is to provide fuel fabrication and material corrosion evaluation services to the Danish developer of floating molten salt reactors Saltfoss for its seaMSR-100 reactor over the next two years.

items.title: US Launch Pad supports reactor and fuel projects
items.summary: Projects included in the second round of selections under the US Nuclear Energy Launch Pad initiative to promote the rapid development and implementation of advanced nuclear technologies by private industry include companies focused on fuel cycle innovation as well as reactor developers, with plans for a new conversion facility and a fuel fabrication plant at Idaho National Laboratory.

items.title: Finland's readiness for nuclear emergencies assessed by IAEA
items.summary: Strengthening national coordination is one of the recommendations made by an International Atomic Energy Agency team which identified a number of strengths in Finland's preparedness and response framework for nuclear and radiological emergencies.

items.title: Consortium formed for Swedish SMR project
items.summary: Studsvik has selected GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy and Samsung C&T as its strategic partners for an initial four-unit BWRX-300 small modular reactor project, either at its existing licensed nuclear site in Nyköping or at the Målma site in Valdemarsvik.

items.title: Project to consider trans-Atlantic nuclear-powered cargo ships
items.summary: UK-based classification society and professional advisory service Lloyd's Register, Danish global shipping company AP Moller-Maersk, the USA's Port of Charleston and the UK's Port of Felixstowe are partnering to examine the security and safeguarding requirements for the theoretical trans-Atlantic deployment of nuclear-powered container ships.
